title: Vaporesso XTank T Replacement Glass 2ml
description: This official 2ml replacement glass is designed specifically for the Vaporesso XTank T tank. It restores your tank’s capacity and is a straightforward swap if the original glass becomes cracked or damaged. The precise fit helps maintain the tank’s leak-resistant structure when installed with the correct seals. For best results, power off your device, remove the tank from the mod and ensure the O-rings are in good condition before fitting the new glass. Re-seat the seals carefully and check for a snug fit before refilling.
